name: tour
description: A guided tour of agent-test: project work, diagnosis, repair, MCP tools, skills, and controlled comparisons.

scenarios.name: answers from the project guide
scenarios.description: The agent reads one project fact and gives a grounded answer.
scenarios.prompt: Read PROJECT.md. Who owns this project? Reply with one short sentence.

scenarios.name: finds the cause of a status bug
scenarios.description: The agent reads the source and test, runs one test, and explains the cause.
scenarios.prompt: Find the cause of the failing status test. Read the source and the test. Run bun test. Explain the cause. Do not change any file.

scenarios.name: repairs the status bug
scenarios.description: The agent makes the smallest repair and runs the focused test.
scenarios.prompt: Repair the status bug in src/status.ts. Change only that source file. Run bun test. End with TASK_STATUS_FIXED.

scenarios.name: uses the issue service
scenarios.description: The agent calls a local MCP tool and uses the returned task requirement.
scenarios.prompt: Call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with its current due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only. Do not use a file tool or a shell tool.

scenarios.name: follows the release skill
scenarios.description: The agent loads one project skill and follows its narrow rule.
scenarios.prompt: Use the release-note skill. Return only the release note.

scenarios.name: compares three MCP workflows
scenarios.description: Determines which task lookup workflow is most accurate and efficient.
scenarios.prompt: Determine which task lookup workflow provides the most accurate result with the fewest tools and tokens.

arms.label: summary only
arms.description: Reads only the task summary, which is out of date.
arms.prompt: Call search_tasks for TASK-104. Use only that result. Reply with the due date only.

arms.label: search then detail
arms.description: Searches for the task and then reads its current record.
arms.prompt: Call search_tasks for TASK-104. Then call get_task with the returned ID. Reply with the current due date only.

arms.label: direct detail
arms.description: Reads the current task directly because the ID is known.
arms.prompt: Call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with the current due date only.

scenarios.name: measures the value of a helpful tool
scenarios.description: The same task runs with and without a task index tool.
scenarios.prompt: Find the current due date for TASK-104. Use the fastest authoritative source. If no task index tool exists, read records/TASK-101.md, records/TASK-102.md, records/TASK-103.md, and records/TASK-104.md separately. Do not use a wildcard. Reply with the date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

a.label: control
a.description: Reads the task records without MCP.

b.label: tool
b.description: Uses one task index MCP tool.
